comment: Dynamic-obstacle motion contract. ONE file drives the obstacles in BOTH the MATLAB simulation (Simulation8_dynamic.m) and the ROS 2 stack (ros2_swarm_transport/mover_node.py). Frame: the Gazebo world / ROS 2 map frame, metres, ENU, CCW-positive - the same frame the MATLAB scripts use, so no transform is ever applied. Motion model: each mover waits at route[0] until t0, then translates along the straight route at 'speed' m/s. loop=false: it stops at route[1] and stays there. loop=true: it shuttles between the endpoints forever, pausing 'wait' seconds at each end. Velocities are piecewise constant, so prediction (constant-velocity) is exact.
